needed.evidence: There is no purpose-built sidewalk under the flyover; pedestrians must walk in the roadway or on the shoulder.
needed.suggestion: Construct a dedicated sidewalk on the right side under the flyover to separate pedestrians from motor traffic.

needed.evidence: The path is a dirt/grass strip without a paved surface.
needed.suggestion: Pave and formalise the informal path on the left side to provide a safe, accessible walking surface.

needed.evidence: The zebra crossing is poorly marked and lacks signalisation or refuges on a wide, high-traffic road.
needed.suggestion: Upgrade the marked crossing to a signalised crossing with a central refuge to improve pedestrian safety.

needed.evidence: A marked crossing exists on a road with 4 or more lanes but lacks a central refuge.
needed.suggestion: Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the crossing to allow people to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
